subject: EU-only processing: implementation details and evidence requests
messages:
From: Eva Müller <eva.mueller@eurobankcorp.eu>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: legal@eurobankcorp.eu, thomas.richter@eurobankcorp.eu
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exploring EU-only processing for EuroBank POC

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the call this morning — EuroBank is keen to validate that we can constrain all processing, logs, backups and admin access to the EU for the POC. Our legal team has a few concrete asks before we sign the mutual action plan:

1) Confirmation that all inference and data storage will be within EU regions (please list regions/providers).
2) Whether Redwood executes SCCs (the 2021/2023 updated standard) as controller-processor, and if you have a template SCC Annex we can review.
3) Explanation of key management: do customer data and keys ever leave EU KMS?
4) Deletion evidence and retention windows — we need a process for proof-of-deletion for model inputs and logs.

Can you send a short technical description we can share with Legal? Attach any diagrams or checklist items.

Best,
Eva Müller\Lead Counsel, Third-Party Risk\EuroBank AG

--
Note: attachment requested: dataflow diagram and SCC execution checklist\

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Eva Müller <eva.mueller@eurobankcorp.eu>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exploring EU-only processing for EuroBank POC

Hi Eva — thanks for the clear list. I pulled together the initial responses below and attached a simple dataflow diagram and our SCC execution checklist. Happy to set a quick follow-up with our security team.

Summary answers (high level):
- EU regions: Hosted and Dedicated deployment options are available in EU (Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Paris). For Private (VPC/on-prem) we can run inside your cloud tenant or on-prem.
- SCCs: We execute the EU Commission SCCs for controller-processor relationships. We can provide a countersigned Annex and our standard Data Transfer Impact Assessment summary.
- KMS & keys: For Dedicated and Private, keys can be customer-managed in EU KMS. For Hosted we offer an EU-region KMS option; keys are not exported outside the EU for EU-region tenants.
- Deletion evidence: We provide deletion audit logs, object tombstone metadata and optional signed attestation for retained PII deletion on request. For high-assurance workflows we can coordinate a technical runbook and evidence export (CSV + signed hash).

Ask from our side before we hand over to Security: are you planning to use Redwood Hosted or Dedicated capacity for the POC? Hosted is the fastest to stand up; Dedicated gives stronger isolation and clear KMS ownership.

Attachments: redwood-eu-dataflow-diagram.pdf, sccs-execution-checklist.xlsx

Cheers,
Jonas Weber\Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference\jonas_weber@redwood.com\+44 7700 900111

From: Thomas Richter <thomas.richter@eurobankcorp.eu>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: legal@eurobankcorp.eu
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 08:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exploring EU-only processing for EuroBank POC

Jonas / Lauren — quick follow-up from Tech Ops. A couple of precise technical clarifications required by our infra team:

- Can you confirm where backups/snapshots are stored and whether they are replicated out of EU under your default Hosted config?
- Are tenant-level admin logs (who accessed what) stored in the same region as the compute? If not, can we opt-out of central logging to US?
- Does Redwood support per-tenant VPC peering for Dedicated so traffic never traverses the public internet?

We'd like to get these in writing so we can proceed to the procurement checklist.

Regards,
Thomas
Cloud Infrastructure Lead
EuroBank AG

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Thomas Richter <thomas.richter@eurobankcorp.eu>, Eva Müller <eva.mueller@eurobankcorp.eu>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 11:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exploring EU-only processing for EuroBank POC

Hi Thomas, Eva — looping in our Product Security and Platform leads to answer precisely. See inline answers below.

- Backups/snapshots: For Hosted EU-region tenants we store backups in the same EU region by default. We do not replicate host backups to non-EU regions unless the customer explicitly enables cross-region DR; that is off for EU-only contracts. (We will include this clause in the Dedicated/Hosted Data Residency Exhibit.)

- Admin logs: Tenant-level access logs and audit trails are retained in EU for EU-region tenants; central operational aggregates (used for platform health) are pseudonymized and do not contain customer PII. If EuroBank requires stricter isolation, Dedicated can use a customer-managed logging bucket inside your cloud account.

- VPC peering and networking: Dedicated supports private peering and VPC endpoints so traffic between your VPC and the Dedicated pool never goes over the public internet. We'll provide a network diagram and the peering checklist.

Next steps: Markus, can you confirm the KMS / deletion attestations details (I included questions below)? Grace, can you prepare a short evidence pack (exportable CSV of deletion logs + signed attestation) and an estimated lead time for delivery.

Thanks — we can also set a technical deep-dive on Friday if that helps.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Thomas Richter <thomas.richter@eurobankcorp.eu>, Eva Müller <eva.mueller@eurobankcorp.eu>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 16:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exploring EU-only processing for EuroBank POC

Following up with the technical confirmations and delivery plan.

- KMS: For Dedicated and Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (CMK) in the customer's EU KMS (AWS KMS / Google Cloud KMS / Azure Key Vault). Keys and key material never leave the EU region. For Hosted EU tenants we provide an option to bring your own key (BYOK) with a customer-controlled KMS in EU; if you choose Redwood-managed keys we restrict key material to the EU region for the EU tenancy.

- Deletion evidence: We will provide a deletion evidence package that contains: object identifiers, deletion timestamps, tombstone hashes, and an audit signature. Typical delivery: initial package within 10 business days after request; faster SLA possible under Dedicated with a short-run attestation process.

- Backup and replication: By default backups are retained in-region. We will include a Data Residency Exhibit that prohibits cross-border replication for EuroBank unless you explicitly opt-in and sign the DR exception.

- Next steps & proposed timeline:
  * Friday 14 Nov: Technical deep-dive with EuroBank infra/security (1 hour)
  * Week of 17 Nov: Provide countersigned SCC Annex + DTA summary
  * Within 10 business days of countersignature: delivery of deletion evidence package on request

I've attached the dataflow diagram and SCC checklist we referenced. If that timeline works I'll prepare the countersign draft for Legal (Lauren to review).

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Security
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: redwood-eu-dataflow-diagram.pdf (pdf), sccs-execution-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
